title: International Artist article on the Sketch Easel
content: The new issue ofInternational Artistmagazine (#116/August/Sept. 2017) has a feature on how to make a sketch easel. Pick up a copy or order online.Don't miss the previous GurneyJourney posts: "Your DIY Pochade Easel Designs" and "Sketch Easel Materials."-----Be part of the maker community. Get yourself a copy of "How to Make a Sketch Easel".The 1080p HD download isavailable now for just $14.95 from Gumroad.The DVD version is available for $24.50, and it includes a slide show.The DVD is alsoavailable on Amazon.
